## ✨ Summary
What feature does this PR add?

- [ ] User-facing change
- [ ] API change

Briefly describe the approach, key components, and trade-offs.

- [ ] Integration tests added/updated

## ✅ Acceptance criteria
List criteria that validate the feature works as intended.
